newsitem.title: USA: Littelfuse Q1 net up on foreign sales gain.
newsitem.headline: Littelfuse Q1 net up on foreign sales gain.

text.p: Littelfuse Inc said Wednesday strong international sales and the successful new product launches helped fuel a double-digit earnings increase in the first quarter ended March 28.

The company, which makes electronic, power and automotive fuses, earlier reported net income of $6.3 million or $0.53 a share compared to $5.2 million or $0.42 a year ago. Net sales rose to $65.6 million from $59.1 million in the first quarter of 1996, Littelfuse said.
The company added it is cautiously optimistic it will continue its growth this year as it launches reinvestment and international expansion programs.
Littelfuse shares were unchanged Wednesday at 45.
